# stages/policy/queues

Training and evaluation queues. Each chain has one run list (one line per run: name, reference and parameters). `day2_train_chain.sh` and `arm_*.sh` read these lists. The file name prefix is the host
(`mf` = mf4090, `ml` = ml40, `l` = l40n). After a chain finishes, its file does not change again. The file stays as the provenance of that run.

<!-- index start: generated by tools/repo_index.py, do not edit by hand -->

506 files, merged into 177 chains. The file-name prefix is the host. The run list holds the full training runs, smoke holds the short runs that go first, and expected config is the positive configuration that `precheck_expect.sh` checks. Grouped by host, newest change first.
